Here is a comprehensive breakdown of everything related to quality reports in the codebase.

---

## 1. Where Quality Reports are Displayed

**Primary page:** `src/pages/QualityReports.tsx`
- Accessible at the route `/metrics/quality`
- Registered in `src/main.tsx` as `qualityRoute`
- Linked from the navigation menu in `src/config/applicationMenu.tsx` (menu item `'quality-reports'`)

The page has two layers of UI:
- A **summary table** listing all repos with quality reports enabled
- A **`ReportDialog` modal** (inline in the same file) that appears when a row is clicked, showing full report details + a trend chart

**Secondary reference:** `src/pages/RepoSettings.tsx`
- Shows a `qualityReportEnabled` toggle for each repo in the settings table (column label: "Quality")

---

## 2. Table Columns in the Summary View

Defined at line 88 of `QualityReports.tsx`:

| Column | Source field |
|---|---|
| Workspace | `repo.workspace` |
| Repo | `repo.repoSlug` |
| Archetype | `repo.archetype` |
| Version | `repo.archetypeVersion` |
| Score | `report.score` (rendered as `ScoreBadge`) |
| Linter Errors | `report.linter.errorCount` |
| Avg Complexity | `report.complexity.avgComplexity` |
| Last Measured | `report.measuredAt` |
| _(empty)_ | "View" link |

---

## 3. API Calls

All calls go through `src/lib/api` (an axios instance):

| Call | Method | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|
| Fetch all repos | `GET` | `/settings/repos` |
| Fetch latest quality report | `GET` | `/metrics/quality-reports/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/main` |
| Fetch historical reports | `GET` | `/metrics/quality-reports/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/main/history` |
| Trigger a new quality report job | `POST` | `/metrics/quality-reports/{workspace}/{repoSlug}/main` |

The POST body is `{ repoUrl: string }` and returns `{ jobId: string }`. On success, it navigates to `/jobs/$id`.

---

## 4. Types and Interfaces

All defined in `src/types/api.ts` (lines 140–172):

```142:172:src/types/api.ts
export interface CoverageSection {
  lineCoverage?: number
  branchCoverage?: number
  methodCoverage?: number
}

export interface LinterSection {
  errorCount?: number
  warningCount?: number
  infoCount?: number
}

export interface QualityReport {
  reportId: string
  workspace: string
  repoSlug: string
  branch: string
  measuredAt: string
  score?: number
  coverage?: CoverageSection
  linter?: LinterSection
  aikido?: { issueCount?: number; criticalCount?: number }
  complexity?: {
    avgComplexity?: number
    maxComplexity?: number
    totalMethods?: number
    methodsAboveThreshold?: number
    threshold?: number
  }
  reviewQuality?: { avgScore?: number; totalReviews?: number }
}
```

The `RepoSettings` interface (lines 67–84) also contains the `qualityReportEnabled: boolean` flag that gates which repos appear on the quality reports page.

**`JobType`** in `src/types/api.ts` line 25 includes `'QUALITY_REPORT'` as a valid job type, so triggered jobs will appear with that classification on the Jobs page.

---
